scripts.dev:stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force }; Write-Host 'Dev server stopped (port 3000).' } else { Write-Host 'No dev server on port 3000.' }"
scripts.dev:restart: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev
